metrics.label: Expected goals (xG)
metrics.definition: Sum of the chance quality of every shot: the probability each shot is scored.

metrics.label: Shots on target
metrics.definition: Shots that were scored or saved.

metrics.label: Expected threat added (xT)
metrics.definition: How much completed passes increased the chance of scoring, from a 12x8 zone grid learned from simulated matches.

metrics.label: Field tilt
metrics.definition: Share of passes played in the final third.

metrics.label: Average pass difficulty
metrics.definition: 1 - expected completion probability, from length, depth and pressure.

metrics.label: PPDA (pressing)
metrics.definition: Opponent build-up passes allowed per defensive action high up the pitch. Lower = more intense pressing.

metrics.label: Pressures
metrics.definition: Times a player closed down the ball carrier.

metrics.label: Fastest shot
metrics.definition: Highest ball speed of any shot.

projection.note: A projection from the score, time left and chance creation, not betting odds.
